engineRegistry.rule: Independent votes require materially different alpha-generation methodology, not merely a different version, filter, weighting scheme, risk overlay or branch name.

engineIndependenceAudit.rule: Independent votes require materially different alpha-generation methodology, not merely a different version, filter, weighting scheme, risk overlay or branch name.

engines.alphaGeneration: Calibrated supervised TOP10 probability from historical feature vectors; adaptive basket size; equal basket weighting.
V19 TOP10 probability ranking; ATR<=8 preference; inverse-volatility weighting; prior-loss exposure overlay.
Deterministic full-market evidence composite: data evidence, liquidity, multi-method S/R, net risk/reward, trade-plan alignment and current technical evidence; no legacy alpha score contribution.
